description: This is the main source file for the NoteGPT backend API; it sets up a FastAPI application with endpoints for user authentication, note management, YouTube AI processing, exporting notes, and sharing functionality.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: The main FastAPI application instance configured for the project.

methods.name: register_user(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with email and password.

methods.name: login_user(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint for user login, returning a JWT token.

methods.name: create_note( note_in: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Create a new note, optionally with AI transcription and summarization from YouTube.

methods.name: list_notes( db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieve all notes belonging to the authenticated user.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieve a specific note by its ID, with access control.

methods.name: edit_note(note_id: int, note_edit: NoteEdit, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Edit an existing note owned by the user.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Delete a note owned by the user.

methods.name: ingest_youtube( youtube_url: str = Query(..., description="YouTube video URL"), title: str = Query(..., description="Title for the generated note"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None )
methods.description: This endpoint processes a YouTube link to fetch transcript & summary using AI, creating a note.

methods.name: export_note( note_id: int, format: NoteExportFormat = Query(..., description="Export format: pdf or txt"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Export a note as PDF or TXT.

methods.name: share_note( note_id: int, share_mode: NoteShareMode, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Set the sharing mode (public/private) of a note.

methods.name: get_public_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Access a publicly shared note without authentication.

methods.name: root()
methods.description: Root endpoint providing basic API info.
